# Storage retention plan for issue #1871

Census UTC: `2026-10-22T12:38:05.225Z`. Mode: dry-run only. Source revision:
`cf68c1d953bae912450825c5352cf1fc92297ad4`. This plan supersedes the
2026-10-09 snapshot for this attempt; changes in counts are fleet drift, not reclamation.

The census scanned 220 checkout roots. Of these, 130 had candidate rows
(5,099 rows total), and 90 had none.
Apparent bytes total 8,224,709,825; btrfs exclusive bytes total
7,995,277,312. Every row has an exclusive-byte measurement. These are
retained data measurements. Shared extents and directory overhead mean that these
figures cannot establish physical reclaim.

```sh
bun run beep quality residue-reap --fleet --classes checkout-qa \
  --classes checkout-qualification --classes checkout-generated \
  --classes checkout-jobs --classes checkout-ledgers --classes checkout-pids \
  --classes checkout-material --json
bun run beep session open
```

## Evidence and rulings

`L` means the saved `session open` checkout rows. The read returned 44
live rows, including blocked sessions; blocked is retained work. An exact checkout
or ancestor/descendant checkout match protects a row. Session identities and
message bodies stay private.

`P` means `/proc/*/cwd` read at `2026-10-22T12:38:23.741182+00:00`. It observed
298 process cwd links under Beep projects. `path` counts processes
under the candidate; `checkout` counts processes under its checkout. Either a
ledger match or a checkout process makes the row live. Protecting the whole
checkout is conservative and includes the brief's required candidate-path test.
No process arguments or secret-bearing environment were read.

922 process cwd links were unreadable, including 17 owned by
the current uid. A row with no observed holder remains `unknown`; that incomplete
read cannot establish the absence required for TERMINAL. Process/ledger reads
are snapshots and do not prevent later activity.

All 5,099 census owners are `owner-unverified`. The checkout column identifies
the ownership boundary, not a person or an approved archive ruling. The brief
excludes unattributed data from apply. Primary-clone and practice-services rows
are explicitly excluded. Material rows stay owner-required, preserving the
receipt's research/corpus/runtime exclusions. No row is ruled TERMINAL.

The tool itself skips 5,098 foreign rows and one invoking-lane material
row. `ResidueReap.ts` makes fleet checkout archives observation-only and requires
execution from the owning checkout. A tracked JSON ruling must also match the
owner checkout's `.beep/retention/<class>.json`. Neither boundary is bypassed.
The lane brief permits writes only in this lane. No owner notices were sent.
